description: Output options on a small multi-file build (src/interop on lodash's CommonJS modules, PRUNE from src/main.js): --output_wrapper (%output% and %output|jsstring%), --output_wrapper_file, --isolation_mode=IIFE, --assume_function_wrapper, source map content and location mappings, --json_streams IN, OUT and BOTH (with input source maps in the JSON), manifests, and the --dependency_mode variants.
